    Description

    Alpine Eagle 41
    Ref. Number: 298600-3001
    Contemporary, refined and assertive, the new sport-chic Alpine Eagle timepiece collection is a contemporary reinterpretation of the St Moritz, the first watch created in 1980 by Karl-Friedrich Scheufele, now copresident of the Chopard house. Imagined and personally designed by him, the Alpine Eagle was driven by his passion for the Alps and by the lofty power of the eagle that reigns supreme there. Crafted from an exclusive, ultra-resistant, light-reflecting metal named Lucent Steel™ –, it beats to the rhythm of a Chronometer-certified movement. Alpine Eagle is dedicated to contemporary eagles, the aspiring men who outperform in their daily lives and whose vision inspires and elevates. With foresight and determination, they act on the challenges of tomorrow and are innately aware of the importance of environmental issues.

    Specifications

    Metal
    Stainless steel
    Case Diameter
    41 mm
    Thickness
    9.70 mm
    Dial
    In a blue colour obtained by galvanic treatment - finish design inspired by the iris of the eagle - rhodium-plated Roman numerals and hour markers coated with Super-LumiNova
    Water-Resistant
    100 metres
    Case-Back
    Front glass, See-through sapphire crystal
    Crown Material
    Stainless steel
    Crown Type
    Screw-down crown
    Front Glass
    Sapphire glass

    Entirely developed, produced and assembled in the Chopard watchmaking workshops, the self-winding mechanical Chopard 01.01-C caliber is a COSC-certified chronometer that oscillates at a frequency of 28,800 vibrations per hour. With a power reserve of 60 hours and a stop-second function, it displays the hours, minutes, seconds and date with the precision and elegance that characterize Chopard.
    Movement
    CHOPARD 01.01-C
    Type of Winding
    self-winding mechanical movement
    Function
    date, hours and minutes, seconds
    Complications
    stop seconds
    Power Reserve
    Power Reserve of approximately 60 hours
    Certification(s)
    Certified chronometer (COSC)
    Frequency
    4 Hz (28,800 vibrations per hour)
    Decoration on Movement
    bridges adorned with snailed motif, circular-grained mainplate
    Balance Spring
    flat
    Balance Wheel
    with three spokes
    Movement Thickness
    4.95 mm
    Number of Movement Parts
    207
    Jewels
    31

    Bracelet type
    Metal bracelet
    Buckle Type
    Folding clasp

    Online Services

    We accept all major debit and credit cards such as Visa, MasterCard, American Express and other payment methods such as PayPal.

    During the checkout process, the supported payment methods are displayed on screen.

    All online transactions are secure and performed on a server that uses industry-standard encryption technology to protect your information.

    Access our full privacy policy.

    We offer free express delivery on all online orders. Orders are shipped from Switzerland.

    Our goal is to process orders for in-stock merchandise within 48 hours (2 business days) of receipt.

    Orders are processed Mon-Fri, excluding holidays.

    If for any reason you decide not to keep your online purchase, Chopard will accept merchandise in its original condition for full refund within thirty (30) days from the date of delivery.

    Please note that fragrances cannot be returned.

    Visit our return portal to register your return and download the complimentary return shipping label.

    Due to merchandising restrictions, all returns must be shipped from the same country where the order was delivered.

    See our full Terms of Sales.

    Extend the International Warranty for your Chopard watch or jewellery.

    Upon registration of your Chopard watch or jewellery on our dedicated online platform, the duration of the original International Warranty will be extended to five years.

    Furthermore, you will receive personalized maintenance advice and communications related to your Chopard watch or jewellery.

    You can view the full details of our Warranty Extension here.
